notes: Added _fr4b_calibration_banner() function and its call site immediately after the _fr4a_check call and before install_gitnexus. The function implements three variants: NEVER RUN (events file absent or no calibration_result event for mechanism fr-4b-gitnexus-grammar-skip), STALE (most-recent event older than 14 days, with day count in message), and silent (within threshold). All steps use || true / graceful-degrade guards; jq absence silently degrades to no-output. The banner emits only to stderr and does not write any mcp-events.jsonl record (AC-X-4 compliant). L1 (bash -n) clean. L2 grep hits confirmed on both banner strings at correct file position (between _fr4a_check and install_gitnexus). L3 simulation of all three cases: (a) absent file produces NEVER RUN output; (b) stale event 30 days old produces STALE output with day count; (c) recent event 2 days old produces no output. All cases exit 0 and proceed to install_gitnexus without fail-close.
